افتعلنا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَعَلْنَا (iftaʕalnā) /if.ta.ʕal.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
# اُفْتُعِلْنَا (uftuʕilnā) /uf.tu.ʕil.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
